Produced 72 gaps across all 10 epics, merged idempotently into data/gaps.json + regenerated CSVs. completion_status.requirements = complete. Prerequisite for the user's grill-me-on-scope request.

gap_analysis.phase_0_basis: 72 gaps far exceeds the >15 threshold; source conflicts (1) below the >5 threshold but capability gaps (5) include missing transactional write clients (Party-master, Anatel sync) and the unmodeled interview engine
cross_cutting_themes: Experience-design discipline gap on every user-facing surface (V360 cockpit, 300-step interview, agentic capture, omnichannel console, Aliado) — none scoped; ties directly to the -15% TMA / +FCR ARI success criteria (G0405, G0505, G0607, G0807, G0908, G0306)

Governance discipline gap: no owner for regulated-flow change control, MCP cross-pillar contract versioning, routing-rule governance, AI-agent policy/audit, data stewardship/DSR (G0404, G0602, G0806, G0907, G0504, G1005)
No TMA/FCR baseline captured anywhere — the ARI's headline outcomes cannot be evidenced at go-live (G0507, G0903)
Pillar 2 MCP handoff contract undefined and load-bearing for PROCP+COPM (G0601, G0701) — the single Source Conflict
Cross-domain sequencing not reflected in the parallel-squad model: CPM-04 blocks on FND-04+INT-08; SDP agentic surface is downstream of S2/S3/S5 (G0403, G0904)
SCV/Amazon Connect telephony infra ownership external + Genesys EOL Dec-2027 hard window (G0105, G0802)
Capability gaps in the integration count: no Party-master WRITE client, no Anatel status-sync client (G1001, G1002, G0301)
